symbols.name: Fire
symbols.description: The symbol of flame and heat. One of the first symbols discovered after the collapse, often manifesting to those who survived great destruction.
symbols.discovery_hint: Found in places of great burning or given by those who have witnessed flames.

symbols.name: Water
symbols.description: The symbol of flow and moisture. Said to have first appeared to travelers dying of thirst.
symbols.discovery_hint: Rivers and those who tend them may share this knowledge.

symbols.name: Earth
symbols.description: The symbol of stone and stability. Those who work the land sometimes feel its resonance.
symbols.discovery_hint: Farmers and miners occasionally discover this through their labor.

symbols.name: Air
symbols.description: The symbol of wind and breath. Travelers exposed to great storms have reported visions of this symbol.
symbols.discovery_hint: High places and those who survived storms may reveal this.

symbols.name: Force
symbols.description: The symbol of raw physical power. A fundamental building block for many combinations.
symbols.discovery_hint: Teachers of basic magic often begin here.

symbols.name: Life
symbols.description: The symbol of vitality and growth. Healers and those who nurture life may come to know this symbol.
symbols.discovery_hint: Those who preserve life against great odds sometimes receive this gift.

symbols.name: Void
symbols.description: The symbol of emptiness and absence. A dangerous symbol that responds to loss and negation.
symbols.discovery_hint: Places of great emptiness or those who have lost much may encounter this.

symbols.name: Light
symbols.description: The symbol of illumination and clarity. Often associated with truth and revelation.
symbols.discovery_hint: Moments of great clarity or places untouched by shadow may reveal this.
